levels.label: HD
levels.description: A clear, well-sequenced thesis carried consistently through each section.

levels.label: DI
levels.description: A clear thesis; most sections connect back to it, with minor lapses.

levels.label: CR
levels.description: Thesis is present but sequencing is uneven; some sections drift from it.

levels.label: PS
levels.description: Thesis is implied rather than stated; the essay reads as a sequence of points.

levels.label: FL
levels.description: No identifiable thesis or argument.

levels.label: HD
levels.description: Sources are current, credible, and integrated — not just listed.

levels.label: DI
levels.description: Credible sources, mostly integrated into the argument.

levels.label: CR
levels.description: Adequate sources, though some are listed rather than used.

levels.label: PS
levels.description: Few sources, weakly connected to the claims they support.

levels.label: FL
levels.description: Little or no evidence offered.

levels.label: HD
levels.description: Goes beyond description to weigh competing explanations.

levels.label: DI
levels.description: Evaluates some alternatives, though not always in depth.

levels.label: CR
levels.description: Mostly descriptive, with occasional analysis.

levels.label: PS
levels.description: Largely descriptive; little evaluation of ideas.

levels.label: FL
levels.description: No analysis evident.

levels.label: HD
levels.description: Precise, concise prose with few mechanical errors.

levels.label: DI
levels.description: Clear prose with minor errors that don’t affect meaning.

levels.label: CR
levels.description: Generally understandable; some errors slow the reader.

levels.label: PS
levels.description: Meaning is mostly clear, but errors are frequent.

levels.label: FL
levels.description: Frequent errors obscure meaning.
